evals.name: filter-authors
evals.prompt: Implement a server-paged AuthorsNamed on the Mongo-backed Author read model.
assertions: Filters by the supplied name and orders by a stable ID.
Does not materialize or manually skip and take.

evals.name: filtered-count
evals.prompt: Three Asters and one Birch exist. Verify the first two pages of Asters at size two.
evals.expected_output: Adjacent pages with a stable filtered total.
assertions: Requests page zero followed by page one.
Checks two distinct IDs then the remaining ID.
Checks paging.totalItems is three on both pages.

evals.name: client-sort
evals.prompt: Can I depend on my default Id order when the client supplies sortBy?
evals.expected_output: Account for the renderer's requested sorting.
assertions: States that sortBy replaces the default ordering.
Leaves sorting and paging in the database.
Avoids using reserved paging and sorting parameters as filter names.
